title: Legal Notice on the Commencement Instrument (EAC Competition Act, 2006)
text:
8 EASTAFRICAN COMMUNITYGAZETTE 23rd January, 2015
Legal Notice No. EAC/2/2015.
LEGALNOTICE
IN EXERCISE of the powers conferred on the Council of Ministers by Section 1 of the EAC Competition Act, 2006, the 1st
day of December, 2014, is hereby appointed as the date upon which the EAC Competition Act, 2006 shall come into force.
HON. SAMUELJ. SITTAMP.,
Chairperson, Council of Ministers.
